name: Jakeb Milburn
headline: Software Engineer — ships end to end across ML, mobile, cloud and systems
pitch: I build and ship software end to end — an iOS app on the App Store, production ML pipelines on Azure, the analytics platform a company runs on, agent tooling, a mobile game, and the occasional CUDA kernel. I pick the stack the problem needs and take it all the way to people using it.
